day_shape: 93 items dominated by a heavy Khamenei message cycle marking Defense Week and Nasrallah anniversary, dueling Iran/CENTCOM Hormuz claims after reported Marine injuries, Netanyahu's six-hour UAE trip on Iran, and a UK police probe into a suspected Iran-linked plot on a US-used airbase.

threads.label: Khamenei Defense Week and Nasrallah message
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB pushed out a synchronised message from the Supreme Leader marking Sacred Defense Week and the second anniversary of Hassan Nasrallah's killing, declaring Iran the 'first power in the world' and vowing the era of foreign domination will not return. Defa Press amplified excerpts alongside IRGC commentary on missile-industry milestones and Hamas envoy Khaled Qaddoumi's remarks on Hezbollah's October 8 entry into the war.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz claims and counterclaims
threads.summary: Iran's army deputy Sayyari and IRGC figures said Iran has 'full control' over the Strait of Hormuz and claimed capture of a second US underwater autonomous vehicle, while CENTCOM rejected the claims, citing over a billion barrels of oil transiting freely. The Jerusalem Post reported eight US Marines were injured with smoke inhalation and concussion symptoms in an Iranian attack on a vessel in the Strait, and Iran International cited Iranian state TV analysts saying the UAE has blunted Tehran's Hormuz leverage.

threads.label: Netanyahu UAE trip and nuclear diplomacy
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Netanyahu spent six hours on the ground in the UAE meeting MBZ with Iran the main topic, and separately that mediators are pushing Iran for nuclear concessions in exchange for reviving talks. The reports came alongside analysis of US-Israel divergence over Hormuz and the war with Iran.

threads.label: UK airbase plot probe
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post cited a Telegraph report that UK police are investigating whether Iran was behind a suspected bomb plot targeting a British air base used by US forces in operations against Iran. IRIB separately posted footage it said showed sirens and explosions in Najran and Jazan in southern Saudi Arabia after a missile launch.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and ceasefire violations
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas sniper Adi Adli Abd Al-Aaser in southern Gaza, describing the strike as removing an immediate threat in 'systematic violation of the ceasefire,' with Times of Israel's Fabian confirming the account. Police also released footage of a strike killing Saher Nidal Saqr, a Palestinian involved in the October 7 abduction of Noa Argamani and Avinatan Or.

threads.label: October 7 anniversary reckoning
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya said the group had agreed a roadmap including a Palestinian state, while the Jerusalem Post reported Egyptian intelligence chief Abbas Kamel warned Netanyahu three times of Hamas preparations before October 7. The BBC is reviewing 53 people BBC Arabic listed as journalists killed in Gaza over alleged ties to Hamas and other groups.

threads.label: Israeli coalition friction over Gaza plan
threads.summary: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich and National Missions Minister Orit Strock demanded Netanyahu reject a new 'Board of Peace' plan for Gaza, while thousands including ministers and Knesset members marched from Yad Mordechai toward northern Gaza calling for settlement. The Jerusalem Post also reported on the new INS Drakon submarine built for longer missions near Iran and Yemen.
